|{T Lunge{x
|Syntax: lunge <target>
|
|Lunge is a swift impaling attack available to paladins and vampires. The
|attacker drives their weapon forward in a powerful thrusting motion,
|attempting to pierce the opponent's defenses.
|
|Requires a {Wsword{x, {Wspear{x, or {Wpolearm{x to be wielded. Success
|chance is influenced by size difference, encumbrance, dexterity, haste,
|and the level difference between attacker and target.
|
|Damage scales with weapon dice and skill proficiency. The Enhanced Damage
|skill improves the strike further when it triggers.
|
|Available to: {Wpaladin{x (level 18), {Wvampire{x (level 20)
|
